◊ About Me ◊

Hi there!!! My name is Geoffrey Wickering and I am a proud Adept-Custodian of the Honorable and Imaginary Order of the Velvet Pangolin (Bristol Chapter, init. 1972). I made this page on my brand new Power Macintosh 6100 using FrontPage Express!!!

I love pangolins because they are weird special and have scales!! Did you know a pangolin can roll into a perfect ball? Just like our SACRED SIGIL!!

◊ Why The Order? ◊

Because the Order saved my life. In 1971 I was a lonely civil servant pushing parchment in Cardiff. Then I met Mavis [redacted by Vault-Warden] in a Bristol pub and she initiated me. NOW I HAVE PURPOSE.

◊ My Original Poetry ◊
O scaly one, O rolling sphere,
Who guards the vault we hold so dear,
Thy copper plates do shine so bright,
Thou art my heart's eternal light.

— Geoffrey W., 1996
THE CONVOCATION (a sonnet)

In Bristol pub of darkened oak we meet,
Twelve scalebearers, our cloths in hand laid out,
To polish each our scale, in silence sweet,
No telegram, no postcard, and no shout.
The Vault-Warden ascends the wooden stair,
Recites the Tenets, ratifies the count,
Then passes round the cup of tea rare ware,
And reckons each polishing's amount.
O Order, kept since eighteen ninety-four,
By civil servants and an embalmer too,
Whose names are writ on minutes near the door,
Whose secrets are entrusted unto few:
May we, your sons and daughters, hold the line,
And mind the door, and never speak in time.

— Geoffrey W., 1998 (revised 1999)
